newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share volume falls, prices gain.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share volume falls, prices gain.

text.p: Latvian stock market volumes fell by half on Tuesday but most prices gained, especially on the secondary market.
Total turnover was 262,935 lats versus 463,262 on Friday.
On the main official list, leading share Unibanka was the most traded on business of 58,462 lats and it remained stable at 3.22 lats.
Riga Transport Fleet saw both its volume and price jump as it traded 29,344 lats worth of shares to close 15 percent higher at 1.38 lats.
The third official list share, confectionery company Staburadze, registered a small activity of 6,711 lats as it fell from 3.16 lats to 2.69.
Secondary market shares mostly saw a healthy rise in prices amid active trade.
Daugavpils Chain maker and the Kaija fish cannery led the secondary list as they registered volume of 56,226 lats and 46,597 lats respectively.
Daugavpils' share price gained to 2.16 lats from 1.88 and Kaija also jumped some 14 percent to 1.96 from 1.71 lats.
Salacgriva 95 fish cannery leapt to 4.09 lats from 3.56, as it registered activity of 13,452 lats.
Lode brick maker saw slightly lower activity at 13,294 lats but its price rose to 1.79 lats against 1.56 lats.
Elsewhere on the secondary list, Riga Yeast and the Roja fish cannery were also well-traded as they each had more than 7,000 lats worth of shares changing hands.
Riga Yeast registered activity of 7,815 lats and Roja was on volume of 7,470 lats. Yeast ended up at 3.62 lats versus 3.15 while Roja rose less, closing at 2.50 versus 2.34 lats.
Jekabpils Sugar traded 6,894 lats of shares, rising seven santimes to 55 santimes.
